We will use Markdown files for Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), stored in `docs/adr/`.

Each ADR is a separate Markdown file with a number and a title, e.g., `0001-use-gadr-as-name.md`.

Rationale: We need a lightweight way to record architectural decisions. Many existing ADR formats are too heavy or require specific tooling.

decisions.title: We will use "GADR" (Generalized Architectural Decision Records) as the name for our lightweight ADR
decisions.requirement:
We will use "GADR" (Generalized Architectural Decision Records) as the name for our lightweight ADR format.

Rationale: We have been using "ADR" as the term for Architectural Decision Records, but this causes confusion with other ADR formats (like the original Michael Nygard format). We need a distinct name for our lightweight ADR format.
